reviews.text: Found this clean and quiet place to smoke weed! Always come here to chill with my friends whenever they want to smoke weed. Can even play pool for free and can buy water soft drinks or alcohol if you like. Very clean place and well maintained! Staff can speak enough English to communicate about weed so no issues at all. Staff is very friendly as well! Highly recommended for anyone looking for a serene place to be high

Great selection of weeds! Staff were very helpful and friendly. Quality of weed is great as well. Very chill quiet place for you and your friends to relax. They sell drinks and alcohol as well! Clean and very nice decoration. Modern look! 10/10 recommended!
Nice shop , but not my favourite place to be !
It's a very nice place, all the products are of good quality, the music is good, the coffee is perfect, the staff are very good and kind. I love this shop
Really nice shop, good stuff and place to smoke and chill, recommended!
I had a wonderful experience here, very welcoming and nice place to relax to get away from the chaos of the walking street. Thanks to Kwan for giving me a place to chill 😎😎😎
